title: 10 Late-Night Runs That Explain Duquesne University
description: Ten under-21-safe food stops with directly verified evening, overnight, or 24-hour availability on campus and around Pittsburgh.

cards.title: The 24/7 Rockwell Hall Stop
cards.subtitle: Sixth floor of Rockwell Hall
cards.notes: Check building access first, then head upstairs for packaged food, snacks, drinks, or locally roasted coffee at any hour.
cards.short_summary: A round-the-clock campus option tied to Rockwell Hall access.
cards.evidence_claim: Duquesne lists The Business Leader Bistro on Rockwell Hall's sixth floor and gives it 24/7 academic-calendar hours with building access.
cards.access_notes: Listed as open 24/7 during the academic calendar, but entry depends on access to Rockwell Hall; hours may change.

cards.title: The 2 A.M. Towers Market
cards.subtitle: Entrance to Towers Residence Hall
cards.notes: Use this campus stop for grab-and-go sandwiches, salads, and snacks; mobile ordering and several campus payment methods are accepted.
cards.short_summary: The campus market with a documented 2 a.m. closing time every day.
cards.evidence_claim: Duquesne identifies Campus Market at the Towers Residence Hall entrance and lists daily academic-calendar service until 2 a.m.
cards.access_notes: Academic-calendar hours are 7 a.m.–2 a.m. weekdays and 8 a.m.–2 a.m. weekends; university notes that hours may change.

cards.title: The All-Hours Fisher Grab-and-Go
cards.subtitle: Inside Fisher Hall
cards.notes: Confirm Fisher Hall access before setting out, then choose from prepared salads, sandwiches, wraps, snacks, and beverages.
cards.short_summary: A 24/7 express market for people who can enter Fisher Hall.
cards.evidence_claim: Duquesne lists Fisher Market Express inside Fisher Hall, describes its prepared grab-and-go selection, and posts 24/7 hours with building access.
cards.access_notes: Listed as open 24/7 during the academic calendar, subject to access to Fisher Hall; hours may change.

cards.title: The 10 P.M. Union Pickup
cards.subtitle: Second floor of the Gormley Student Union
cards.notes: Go behind the Union welcome desk for the rotating grab-and-go selection, but reserve this run for Sunday through Thursday evenings.
cards.short_summary: A weekday-focused Union stop featuring food from Pittsburgh businesses.
cards.evidence_claim: Duquesne places Connections behind the Union welcome desk and lists Sunday–Thursday service until 10 p.m., with earlier Friday–Saturday closing.
cards.access_notes: Open Sunday–Thursday from 7 a.m.–10 p.m.; Friday and Saturday service ends at 5 p.m.

cards.title: The 9 P.M. Union Food Court
cards.subtitle: First floor of the Gormley Student Union
cards.notes: Choose the grill, a customizable salad, or an in-person Duq Station sub before the food court reaches its nightly closing time.
cards.short_summary: A customizable campus meal stop open through 9 p.m. all week.
cards.evidence_claim: Duquesne locates The Incline on the Student Union's first floor and lists academic-calendar hours through 9 p.m. every day.
cards.access_notes: Open 7 a.m.–9 p.m. Monday–Friday and 10:30 a.m.–9 p.m. Saturday–Sunday; hours may change.

cards.title: The 9 P.M. Union Coffee Stop
cards.subtitle: Second floor of the Gormley Student Union
cards.notes: Use this for a Monday–Thursday or Sunday evening drink run; Friday and Saturday service finishes substantially earlier.
cards.short_summary: The campus coffee counter with selected 9 p.m. closing times.
cards.evidence_claim: Duquesne locates Starbucks on the Union's second floor and lists closing at 9 p.m. Monday–Thursday and Sunday.
cards.access_notes: Open until 9 p.m. Monday–Thursday and Sunday; Friday and Saturday closing is 5 p.m. Hours may change.

cards.title: The Forbes Avenue Burger Run
cards.subtitle: 1023 Forbes Avenue beside Duquesne
cards.notes: Head to the Uptown counter before 9 p.m. for burgers, chicken, fries, salads, or a plant-based burger; the restaurant also has kids' meals.
cards.short_summary: A public Forbes Avenue restaurant that accepts Duquesne Flex and PLUS.
cards.evidence_claim: Moonlit Burgers' official site lists its Uptown location at 1023 Forbes Avenue as open Monday–Saturday until 9 p.m.; Duquesne says the public location accepts Flex and PLUS.
cards.access_notes: Uptown is open Monday–Saturday from 11 a.m.–9 p.m.; the official page does not list Sunday service.

cards.title: The South Side Pizza Run
cards.subtitle: 1001 East Carson Street
cards.notes: Check the live store page before leaving, then choose delivery or carryout; the location sells pizza, sandwiches, pasta, salads, and desserts.
cards.short_summary: A South Side branch with verified service well after midnight.
cards.evidence_claim: Domino's official location page identifies the 1001 East Carson Street restaurant and displayed service until 3:30 a.m. when fetched.
cards.source_title: Domino's Pizza at 1001 E Carson Street
cards.access_notes: The official live listing displayed “Today Until 3:30 AM” when fetched; store hours vary, so recheck before ordering.

cards.title: The Downtown Pizza Run
cards.subtitle: 625 Stanwix Street
cards.notes: Use the official listing to confirm the night's closing time and ordering options before making the trip from the Bluff into Downtown.
cards.short_summary: A Downtown pizza branch whose official listing extends past midnight.
cards.evidence_claim: Domino's official Pittsburgh listings identify the 625 Stanwix Street restaurant and displayed service until 2 a.m. when researched.
cards.access_notes: The official listing displayed service until 2 a.m. when researched; hours vary by day and should be rechecked before departure.

cards.title: The 2 A.M. West Pittsburgh Taco Run
cards.subtitle: 121 Costco Drive
cards.notes: Treat this as a drive or delivery run, and verify the live listing first; the official page currently shows both drive-through and dine-in service.
cards.short_summary: A farther Pittsburgh option with documented 2 a.m. service every day.
cards.evidence_claim: Taco Bell's official location page identifies the 121 Costco Drive restaurant and lists drive-through hours from 9 a.m. to 2 a.m. daily.
cards.source_title: Taco Bell in Pittsburgh, PA — 121 Costco Drive
cards.access_notes: Official drive-through hours are 9 a.m.–2 a.m. daily; the page also displayed dine-in service until 2 a.m. when fetched.
